title: FOLLOW THE DOT / HEAD STAYS STILL
hook: Keep your head still and chase this dot up to 380 BPM.
hook_candidates: Keep your head still and chase this dot up to 380 BPM.
380 BPM is the final stage. How far do your eyes get?
Most eyes drop this dot somewhere before 380 BPM.
caption:
Keep your head still and chase this dot up to 380 BPM.

Six stages. It starts at a calm 120 and keeps climbing until the dot is flicking corner to corner faster than you can blink. Eyes move, head doesn't.

Comment the level you lost it.
